method: Structured JSON from the Gemini API, instructed by docs/PROJECT_VISION.md@main blob 8cc39ea9d27d. All records provisional.

characters.summary: Valeria is a skilled thief and warrior who fights alongside Conan using swords, daggers, and stealth. She is agile, ruthless in close-quarters combat, and deeply loyal to her allies.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to supernatural entities and piercing weapons like arrows
limitations: Human physical limits without supernatural durability

sources.supports: Valeria's role as a master thief, warrior, and combat skills using swords and daggers alongside Conan.

feats.claim: Infiltrated the Tower of Serpents and stole the Eye of Serpent jewel.
Fought against Thulsa Doom's guards alongside Conan and Subotai.

notableResults.note: Killed by a poisoned arrow fired by Thulsa Doom.

unknowns: Exact background prior to her partnership with Conan and Subotai.

characters.summary: Vernita Green, codenamed Copperhead, is a deadly former assassin specialized in hand-to-hand combat, knife work, and domestic concealment tactics.
weaknesses: Human physical vulnerability to bladed weapons
limitations: Limited to standard human physical capacity and improvised domestic weapons when caught off guard

sources.supports: Vernita Green's identity as Copperhead and her duel with Beatrix Kiddo.

feats.claim: Engaged in a fierce knife and hand-to-hand duel with Beatrix Kiddo in her suburban home.

notableResults.note: Killed during a knife duel in her kitchen after attempting an ambush.

campaignTags.claim: Uses a handgun concealed inside a cereal box.

unknowns: Extent of her syndicate training beyond Deadly Viper assassination methods.

characters.summary: Viggo Tarasov is a ruthless Russian mob boss who commands a vast criminal empire, relying on enforcers, firearms, and financial influence rather than direct brawling.
weaknesses: Advanced age and reliance on subordinates for direct protection
limitations: Physically outmatched by prime combatants in close combat

sources.supports: Viggo Tarasov's position as a New York crime lord and his conflict with John Wick.

feats.claim: Ordered and coordinated the mobilization of multiple assassination teams against John Wick.

notableResults.note: Engaged in a brutal knife and hand-to-hand fight after his empire collapsed, resulting in his death.

unknowns: Exact extent of his personal combat training in his youth.

characters.continuity: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe (2005 film)
characters.summary: Jadis, the White Witch, is a powerful tyrant who uses magical freezing powers, a wand, and a stone-turning staff to dominate Narnia, supported by an army of mythical beasts.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to powerful magical forces and destined champions like Aslan
limitations: Magical power can be broken or countered by higher cosmic forces

sources.supports: Jadis's magical abilities, stone-turning staff, and role as the main antagonist.

feats.claim: Turned numerous Narnian creatures and rebels into solid stone using her magical staff.
feats.citation: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe (2005)

feats.claim: Fought evenly with Peter Pevensie in sword combat during the Battle of Beruna.
feats.citation: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe (2005)

notableResults.citation: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe (2005)
notableResults.note: Defeated and killed by Aslan during the climax of the battle.

campaignTags.claim: Wields innate magical powers to cast spells and freeze enemies.
Plunges Narnia into a perpetual winter through magical dominion.

unknowns: Full origins of her lineage prior to entering Narnia in the film continuity.

characters.continuity: Pirates of the Caribbean film series
characters.summary: Will Turner is a master swordsman and blacksmith who evolves from a capable civilian into an agile pirate captain and eventually the immortal captain of the Flying Dutchman.
weaknesses: Human vulnerabilities in early appearances; bound by cursed duties later
limitations: As captain of the Flying Dutchman, can only step on land once every ten years prior to curse resolution

sources.supports: Will Turner's progression as a swordsman, blacksmith, and captain of the Flying Dutchman.

feats.claim: Dueled evenly with Captain Jack Sparrow and Norrington simultaneously inside a spinning water wheel.
feats.citation: Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest (2006)

feats.claim: Imbued with immortality and supernatural sea powers upon becoming captain of the Flying Dutchman.
feats.citation: Pirates of the Caribbean: At World's End (2007)

notableResults.citation: Pirates of the Caribbean: At World's End (2007)
notableResults.note: Defeated Davy Jones with help from Jack Sparrow, though fatally wounded before being revived as captain.

campaignTags.claim: Accustomed to navigating open oceans and maritime combat.

unknowns: Exact extent of his supernatural command over sea creatures post-curse.

characters.summary: William Wallace is a legendary Scottish rebel leader who fights using a massive two-handed claymore, guerrilla tactics, and inspirational leadership to rally armies against English rule.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to political betrayal and standard human execution methods
limitations: Subject to normal human fatigue and injuries

sources.supports: William Wallace's leadership in the First War of Scottish Independence and his use of the claymore.

feats.claim: Led outnumbered Scottish forces to victory at the Battle of Stirling Bridge using improvised spike walls and disciplined infantry.
Assassinated local English magistrates single-handedly to ignite the Scottish rebellion.

notableResults.note: Won multiple engagements including Stirling Bridge before being captured due to noble betrayal at Falkirk.

unknowns: Historical accuracy versus cinematic dramatization in the film.

characters.summary: Jim Williams is a confident American martial artist and street fighter who combines traditional martial arts with powerful physical strikes and athletic prowess.
weaknesses: Overconfidence against heavily armed or ruthless opponents

sources.supports: Jim Williams's role as a martial artist participating in Han's tournament.

feats.claim: Easily defeated multiple security guards in a street confrontation prior to the tournament.

notableResults.note: Killed by Han during a confrontation on Han's private island.

unknowns: Full extent of his criminal record mentioned by police officers in the opening scene.

characters.summary: The Xenomorph Queen is the colossal, highly intelligent matriarch of the alien hive, capable of commanding drones, laying eggs rapidly, and fighting with razor-sharp limbs and a powerful tail.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to heavy industrial machinery (Power Loader) and extreme heat/explosives
limitations: Heavy mass limits rapid agility compared to smaller drones

sources.supports: Xenomorph Queen's physical attributes, egg-laying capacity, and final battle with Ripley.

feats.claim: Tore herself free from her egg-ovipositor without sustaining critical damage.
Survived exposure to gunfire and explosions while pursuing survivors onto the Sulaco.

notableResults.note: Ejected into space through the airlock after being battered by Ripley operating a cargo loader.

campaignTags.claim: Standing roughly 15 feet tall with massive physical proportions.
Massive towering creature dwarfing human opponents.

unknowns: Exact lifespan and reproductive capacity limits.

characters.summary: Xerxes, the self-proclaimed God King of Persia, rules a massive empire, relying on overwhelming numerical superiority, divine pageantry, and elite shock troops rather than personal combat.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to physical harm despite claiming godhood; bleeds when injured
mobility: carried on an elevated throne by slaves
limitations: Relies entirely on his military forces for combat effectiveness rather than personal martial skill

sources.supports: Xerxes's portrayal as the Persian King leading the invasion of Greece.

feats.claim: Persuaded numerous Greek city-states and warriors to submit to his empire through overwhelming force and luxury.

notableResults.note: Approached Leonidas offering terms of surrender, but was rebuffed and temporarily wounded by a spear.

unknowns: True extent of his personal combat abilities outside of royal pageantry.

characters.summary: Yu Shu Lien is a master martial artist and warrior who wields various traditional weapons with exceptional skill, combining deep tactical wisdom with agile wire-fu combat.
weaknesses: Emotional restraint and honor-bound tactical choices

sources.supports: Yu Shu Lien's mastery of multiple weapons and combat skills.

feats.claim: Fought Jen Yu through a courtyard while cycling through several different stolen weapons (swords, spears, and sabers) with expert proficiency.

notableResults.note: Defeated Jen Yu in a climactic weapon duel, though Jen wielded the mystical Green Destiny sword.

unknowns: Full extent of her training under the Wudang school compared to master Li Mu Bai.
